metadata.description: Claude Code skill plugins by Yoojung Kim — marketing research, creative production, and content automation.

plugins.name: vibe-mkt
plugins.description: 10 marketing skills for brand voice, positioning, copywriting, SEO, email, newsletters, and more. Diagnose your marketing gaps and generate production-ready content.

plugins.name: mkt-study
plugins.description: 9 research skills for market scanning, competitive intelligence, customer profiling, voice-of-customer mining, and strategic synthesis. Build a complete research foundation before marketing execution.

plugins.name: creative-mkt
plugins.description: 7 atomic creative skills for brand visual identity, storytelling frameworks, trend-powered content creation, and AI visual design. Each skill does one thing well with one tool.

plugins.name: card-news
plugins.description: 6 skills for Instagram card-news production: orchestrator, copy-writer, copy-evaluator, contents-manager, image-generator, and card-news-maker. Automates the full pipeline from copywriting to final 1080x1350 PNG rendering.

plugins.name: storyteller
plugins.description: 3 skills for long-form storytelling card-news production: planner, image-maker, and renderer. Transforms newsletters and articles into 11-16 card sets with cinematic or conceptual imagery, rendered as 1080x1350 PNG via Playwright.

plugins.name: cc-skills
plugins.description: 12 development workflow skills for branch management, code review, implementation planning, task estimation, and project management with Linear integration.

plugins.name: ux-skills
plugins.description: 9 UX research and design skills: brainstorming, persona creation, user flow generation, screen planning, interview design, survey building, and user research planning — orchestrated through a context-aware routing system.

plugins.name: vibe-coding
plugins.description: 7 skills for translating ideas into production-ready frontend code. From project discovery to design systems to coding agent prompts.

plugins.name: office-work
plugins.description: 3 skills for business document and presentation production. Includes meeting summary, PPT storyline creation, and report summarization.
